changes: Enemies placed only by area appear on the map as faint circles where they can be, growing while unseen. Hover a circle to see who was seen there and when.
Tag an enemy's spec when the game hides it (always on WoW Forever): hover their row and click a spec icon. Teammates with Share observations on see your tags.
Rows show Alliance and Horde crests instead of OURS/THEIRS and ALLY/ENEMY, the enemy list shows the whole team by default, and Russian, Korean and Chinese names display.
Quick callouts now reach battleground chat in WoW Forever matches, and each alert can have its own sound: choose it in the alert settings or with /hg alerts sound.
WoW Forever: your resurrection countdown also times the enemy's graveyards, and Darkspear Islands reads base owners, names both starts and learns the flag respawn.
notice: Fully quit and restart WoW after updating: this release adds new addon files. CurseForge files may still be in moderation.
